Text: I am Bob. I climbed this tower once, and lived. Let me show you one round of it.
Eight floors, three rooms each. That says how far up you have got. You are at the bottom.
And that is what is in the way. Take its life to nothing and the room is yours.
You. DMG is how hard you hit, AP is what you may spend this round, and the bar is your life.
Five cards, and I have made sure they are the only five you carry. Click that one to queue it.
One action point gone. Every card costs; spend past the bar and you cannot duel at all.
Now look closer. All five are Jabs, and cards that match make a hand. A hand multiplies the whole blow, so take the other four.
Five of a kind. There is no bigger hand in the game and you are holding it. Press it.
Watch the sum. The round was decided before a pixel of it moved; this is only it being shown to you.
Dead in one blow. What it was carrying is yours: vitae, the only coin in this tower. It buys rings, and it is the figure on your card.
Every enemy you fell also has a creature in it. Take one and consume it, and it eats a card of your deck and changes it for good.
Take one, then the card you want it to eat, then confirm. Or take neither and leave — the win has already paid.
And this is what the vitae is for. A ring is what makes an element do anything at all, so buy early and buy cheap.
Spend what you like. When you are done, that is the way back to the tower.
That is the whole of it: build a hand, swing it, take what falls out. Eight floors above you. I will not follow. Climb.
